items.title: ggml/llama.cpp releases: b10321
items.description:
<details open>

metal : fix NORM/RMS_NORM for row lengths that leave a partial simdgroup (#26708)

ggml_metal_op_norm sized the threadgroup with
`nth = std::min(nth, args.ne00_t)`, which can leave nth not a multiple of
the simdgroup size. The kernels finish their row reduction with a
cross-simdgroup
items.summary: The ggml/llama.cpp project released version b10321 to fix NORM/RMS_NORM issues for row lengths that leave a partial SIMD group, ensuring better performance and accuracy in tensor operations. This update is crucial for optimizing the computational efficiency of the model on metal GPUs.
items.summary_detailed: The ggml/llama.cpp project released version b10321, addressing an issue with NORM/RMS_NORM for row lengths that leave a partial SIMD group by adjusting the threadgroup size. This update ensures more efficient kernel execution across SIMD groups, impacting performance in metal-based computations. The broader impact includes improved accuracy and efficiency in processing tasks requiring vectorized operations.
